body.p: The system provides six onboard PCIe slots for installing supported expansion cards, including graphics, storage, networking, management, and other PCIe devices.PCIe slots overview

li.p: Always ensure that the CPU power capability and PSU wattage are sufficient before planning the graphics card configuration. If unsure, contact Lenovo.
Ensure at least one graphics card is installed. If multiple cards are installed, they must be identical.

Install the following PCIe cards (if available) only in their designated slots.
PCIe card Slot
NVIDIA GeForce graphics cards Slot 1
Intel E610-T4 Ethernet adapter
ThinkStation BMC card
Slot 5
ThinkStation USB4 PCIe card Slot 6

The ThinkStation Enterprise Dual Drive Internal Enclosure (EDDIE) occupies Slots 4 and 5. When an EDDIE module is installed, the following devices are not supported in Slot 3 due to thermal constraints.
Graphics cards
M.2 SSD PCIe Gen 5 x4 adapter
Intel E610/E810 Ethernet adapter
Broadcom RAID 940-8i adapter

Populate the PCIe slots in the following priority order.
Without EDDIE
PCIe Gen 5 x16 slot (Slot 3)
PCIe Gen 5 x16 slot (Slot 1)
PCIe Gen 5 x8 slot (Slot 5)
PCIe Gen 4 x4 slot (Slot 2)
PCIe Gen 4 x4 slot (Slot 4)
PCIe Gen 4 x4 slot (Slot 6)
With EDDIE
PCIe Gen 5 x16 slot (Slot 1)
PCIe Gen 5 x16 slot (Slot 3)
PCIe Gen 4 x4 slot (Slot 2)
PCIe Gen 4 x4 slot (Slot 6)
